cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:162.team: 046 - Carlsbad - Sur La Table, 1915 Calle Barcelona, Space #130, Carlsbad, CA 92009
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:162.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. The Culinary Lead contributes to the success of a Sur La Table store by inspiring customers on all points of their culinary journey. The Culinary Lead blends culinary talent, business acumen and teaching skills to support the Resident Chef in driving business results and the staffing and performance management of all culinary employees. The Culinary Lead reports to a Resident Chef.
responsibilities: Models and directs employees to ensure customer service standards are met.
Delivers and holds employees accountable for an exceptional cooking class experience at every class using recipes and game plans provided.
Contributes to an environment where employees are informed and capable by supporting and/or delivering training for all employees.
Maintains proper storage, prep and service procedures and maintains all equipment and workspaces to ensure sanitary conditions.
Ensures all food items are cooked and served at the correct temperature.
Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to employees, maintained and consistently followed.
Provides coaching in the moment and performance feedback to culinary employees.
Seeks opportunities to increase cooking class and retail sales and directs culinary employees to execute sales plans.
Anticipates and solves problems by taking decisive action, follows up with the Resident Chef.
Stays informed by maintaining product knowledge, accesses available training and seeks out additional resources when necessary.
Ensures the accuracy and integrity of employee information including, but not limited to, Time and Attendance records and personal data.
Appropriately partners with Resident Chef, HQ Culinary Team, Human Resources and other departments as needed or necessary.
Demonstrate exceptional verbal and written communication skills with employees, customers, field management and corporate office.
Ensures adherence to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT policy.
May handle, serve, and pour liquor, wine and beer and/or mix ingredients, such as liquor, soda, water and etc. in order to prepare cocktails and other drinks.
Additional responsibilities as assigned by Resident Chef.
qualifications: 1-2 Years progressively responsible kitchen operations or kitchen management experience.
Culinary degree or equivalent Sous Chef experience considered in lieu of degree.
Valid Food Handlers / Food Managers Certification.
Must be at least 21 years old.
Familiarity with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Demonstrated successful teaching and training experience.
Proven ability to drive sales and motivate teams.
Proven training and communication skills.
Proven leadership and financial management skills.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:29a17f1f-7dd7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, Client Delivery based in United States. This is a senior, remote leadership role at the intersection of client delivery and business development. You will own a portfolio of client relationships while shaping opportunities into structured, high-quality pursuits. The role combines account leadership, opportunity architecture, delivery management, and resource direction. You will set quality standards and guide analysts, writers, and contractors without being the primary production resource. Your work will directly influence pipeline growth, client satisfaction, response quality, and operational scalability. The environment is collaborative and distributed, requiring strong judgment, communication, and comfort with asynchronous workflows. Success means creating a repeatable delivery engine where accounts, opportunities, and production pipelines run with minimal executive intervention. Own client relationships: Serve as the primary contact for assigned accounts, lead recurring client calls, establish agendas, monitor relationship health, and ensure timely client updates and reporting. Architect opportunities: Shape qualified opportunities into structured use cases, outlines, and response strategies; assess pursue/no-pursue decisions and establish the quality standard before production begins. Direct delivery resources: Manage the day-to-day work of production analysts, technical writers, and assigned contractors by setting scopes, deliverables, deadlines, and quality expectations. Manage the production pipeline: Own the process from opportunity review and solution architecture through drafting, packaging, and handoff for final leadership review. Maintain delivery standards: Develop and maintain templates, formats, process documentation, coverage matrices, and RACI structures to ensure consistency across accounts. Monitor resources and budgets: Track contractor utilization against approved scopes and budgets, identify variances, and escalate issues when appropriate. Drive business development: Partner with business development leaders to qualify opportunities and maintain accountability for pipeline progression across federal, state, and local pursuits. Support final review and governance: Collaborate with senior leadership on final deliverables and pursuits while ensuring account continuity through documented processes and backup coverage. Build operational maturity: During the first 90 days, transition into ownership of the account portfolio, establish standardized pipeline processes, develop production capacity, and take full responsibility for the delivery workflow. Requirements: Demonstrated experience managing client relationships within government contracting , with the ability to build trust and maintain strong account health. Working knowledge of federal, state, and local procurement , including opportunity qualification, pursuit strategy, and response development. Proven ability to architect written responses, use cases, technical narratives, and other client- or government-facing deliverables. Experience directing writers, analysts, production teams, or contract resources toward clearly defined quality and delivery standards. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide precise direction and establish a high standard for deliverables. Strong judgment and strategic thinking, with the ability to determine when opportunities should be pursued and how resources should be allocated. Ability to manage multiple accounts, opportunities, deadlines, and stakeholders while maintaining consistent delivery quality. Comfortable working in a fully remote environment , coordinating across time zones and managing asynchronous handoffs with distributed or offshore resources. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a46bcdf7-e00b-.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a46bcdf7-e00b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer based in United States. This is a hands-on senior engineering opportunity focused on building and evolving full-stack systems for a growing cloud-based software platform. You will work across backend services, modern web applications, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered product capabilities. The role combines day-to-day software development with ownership of reliability, deployment, observability, and technical quality. You’ll have the opportunity to apply agentic AI tools throughout the engineering lifecycle while also building intelligent product experiences. Working closely with Product, Design, and Quality teams, you’ll help deliver capabilities used by thousands of accounting professionals. This is an environment that values technical ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Design, build, test, and maintain full-stack capabilities across C#/.NET backend services and modern web frontend applications. Develop AI-powered product features using Azure OpenAI Service and related Azure AI capabilities, including document intelligence, semantic search, RAG, tool calling, and multi-step LLM workflows. Use agentic development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and comparable solutions to accelerate coding, code review, refactoring, and technical problem-solving. Build and maintain reliable CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps to support consistent and safe software releases. Design and optimize data access patterns using Azure SQL, Entity Framework Core, and raw SQL when required for performance. Improve platform observability through App Insights, Seq, structured logging, and other monitoring practices to enable rapid diagnosis and resolution of production issues. Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and blameless post-incident reviews while contributing to long-term reliability improvements. Collaborate with Product, Design, and Quality stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, high-quality software solutions. Mentor junior engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to engineering standards and a culture of continuous learning. Help evaluate and implement modern architectural approaches, including containerization, microservices, event-driven systems, and infrastructure automation. Requirements 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in senior or lead engineering positions. Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem, including .NET 6+, ASP.NET Core, and Entity Framework Core. Hands-on experience developing production-grade web frontend applications, including component architecture, state management, and REST API integration. Practical experience with Microsoft Azure PaaS services such as App Services, Azure SQL, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights. Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps. Demonstrated ability to integrate AI capabilities into production applications using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI services, or comparable platforms, including agentic patterns such as multi-step workflows, tool calling, and RAG. Familiarity with Docker, containerization, and modern cloud deployment practices. Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to make sound technical decisions and clearly explain architecture, risks, and tradeoffs. Experience with accounting, financial services, or B2B SaaS environments is a plus. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code using ARM templates or Bicep is preferred. Knowledge of microservices, event-driven architecture, chaos engineering, load testing, capacity planning, security hardening, or SOC 2 environments is advantageous. Azure certifications such as AZ-204 or AZ-400 are a plus. Benefits Remote work-from-home en

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c490d0cf-9e56-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAIL Case Manager Supervisor based in the United States. This is a remote leadership opportunity supporting a specialized behavioral health program serving military personnel following suicide-related incidents. The role provides clinical and operational oversight to a team of SAIL Case Managers while helping ensure high-quality, compliant services. You will collaborate with government stakeholders, program leadership, and clinical professionals to maintain strong program performance. The position combines staff supervision, clinical consultation, quality assurance, recruitment, and contract management responsibilities. You will also contribute directly to training, crisis support, documentation standards, and continuous improvement initiatives. This is a high-impact role for an experienced licensed clinician who thrives in complex, mission-driven environments. Candidates must maintain appropriate clinical credentials and be located within commuting distance of a military installation. Provide direct supervision, performance management, leadership development, and clinical consultation to SAIL Case Managers within the assigned area. Maintain effective relationships with government points of contact and communicate program concerns, personnel matters, policy questions, and contract issues to senior leadership. Monitor contract performance and ensure staffing, service delivery, documentation, reporting, and operational activities remain aligned with program requirements. Conduct regular SAIL record reviews, quality-control activities, audits, and clinical consultations while supporting required quarterly quality-assurance processes. Recruit, interview, select, onboard, and support SAIL Case Managers and Social Service Associates in accordance with established hiring and contract procedures. Ensure staff have the resources, training, guidance, and support required to perform their responsibilities effectively. Provide training on SAIL documentation, policies, procedures, clinical protocols, and applicable program guidance. Review and approve timesheets, monitor leave schedules, support employee engagement, and address performance or compliance concerns. Contribute to monthly and quarterly reporting and identify potential contractual or operational risks requiring escalation and corrective action. Support continuous improvement by identifying challenges, developing solutions, monitoring program changes, and maintaining compliance with applicable standards. Step into the SAIL Case Manager role when necessary to support client needs during staff absences or vacancies. Maintain effective communication with military leadership, government stakeholders, clinical teams, and internal management while protecting confidentiality and exercising sound professional judgment. Requirements: Master’s degree in counseling, social work, or marriage and family therapy from an appropriately accredited program, or a doctoral degree in clinical or counseling psychology with the required accredited clinical internship. Current, valid, unrestricted clinical licensure or certification permitting independent practice, such as LCSW, LMFT, LCP, LPC, LCPC, or LMHC, as applicable. Current clinical credentials and privileges must be maintained throughout the assignment, with professional and ethical conduct consistent with the applicable licensing board. Minimum of 2 years of full-time, post-licensure clinical experience, including recent direct clinical service experience. At least 1 year of experience supervising or managing licensed mental health professionals. At least 2 years of clinical case-management experience and at least 1 year delivering clinical services through telehealth. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e4c27950-74ff-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Meta Ads Consultant based in Portugal. As a Meta Ads Consultant, you’ll take ownership of paid social growth across Facebook and Instagram, helping scale acquisition in key European markets. You’ll shape the strategy from the ground up while remaining deeply involved in campaign execution and optimisation. This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys combining strategic thinking with data-driven decision-making. You’ll work closely with senior marketing stakeholders in a small, agile, international environment. Your work will directly influence lead generation, brand awareness, customer acquisition, and return on advertising spend. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to make a measurable impact within a fast-growing business. It is particularly well suited to an entrepreneurial marketer who prefers action, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Develop and implement a full-funnel Meta advertising strategy tailored to key European markets and target audiences. Plan, launch, manage, monitor, and continuously optimise Facebook and Instagram campaigns focused on lead generation, awareness, and acquisition. Analyse campaign performance, identify trends and opportunities, and translate data into actionable optimisation initiatives. Own paid social performance and continuously improve efficiency, ROI, and overall campaign impact. Collaborate closely with senior product and marketing stakeholders to align paid social activity with broader growth objectives. Advise on and contribute to ad copy, creative concepts, visuals, and landing pages to maximise campaign performance. Prepare clear, insightful performance reports with practical recommendations for future improvements. Continuously test audiences, creatives, messaging, and campaign approaches to identify scalable growth opportunities. Requirements: Proven experience managing and scaling successful Meta advertising campaigns, ideally within startups, scale-ups, or similarly fast-paced environments. Strong expertise in Meta Ads Manager, audience targeting, campaign structure, creative testing, measurement, and performance optimisation. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and turn insights into concrete business actions. Hands-on mindset with the ability and willingness to move seamlessly between strategic planning and detailed campaign execution. Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented approach, with a strong bias toward action and experimentation. Comfortable working independently, taking ownership, and operating effectively within a small and agile team. Fluent English is required; Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or other European languages are considered an advantage. Ability to work effectively within GMT to GMT+3 time zones. Benefits: Opportunity to play a key role in a fast-growing scale-up with international ambitions. Significant ownership and autonomy over Meta advertising strategy and execution. Remote working environment with a small, ambitious, and collaborative team. Freedom to experiment, innovate, and directly influence growth. Competitive consultant compensation. Opportunity to work across multiple European markets and make a measurable commercial impact. southparkcommons-pulley:ashbyhq:607ff5cf.title: Project Manager, Permitting [Louisiana]
southparkcommons-pulley:ashbyhq:607ff5cf.description: About Pulley Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects. Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays. We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams. Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore. What You’ll Do You must be located in Louisiana to be considered for this role. Project Managers are essential to success. As a Project Manager, you are the key link between clients and the intricate permitting landscape. Your work ensures that projects progress smoothly, overcoming regulatory hurdles, and collaborating with municipal officials to speed up approvals. Your expertise and proactive problem-solving directly impact project timelines, making you a critical part of our mission to transform construction. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal part in shaping our permitting operations and work closely with leadership, product, and engineering teams to ensure continuous improvement in how we deliver results. Your contributions will help refine best practices and workflows, pushing the industry forward and enabling our clients to build faster and more effectively. Key Responsibilities: - Permitting Expertise: Gain a deep understanding of local permitting rules across various markets, focusing on streamlining complex processes. - Advise Clients: Act as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through intricate approval processes to achieve fast and efficient outcomes. - Collaborate with Municipalities: Build and maintain strong relationships with municipal staff, working together to accelerate approval times. - Manage Projects: Oversee multiple permitting projects simultaneously, ensuring that each hits key milestones and moves swiftly to completion while anticipating and resolving potential permitting roadblocks, ensuring projects stay on track. - Collaborate Across Teams: Work with internal teams from product, engineering, and leadership to continuously improve Pulley’s platform and enhance the client experience. Who You Are - Professional Experience: 6+ years in architecture, construction, or permitting, with demonstrated involvement in various permitting processes. - Regulatory Knowledge: Strong familiarity with local building codes, zoning regulations, and permitting processes. - Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication abilities and talent for building strong relationships with clients and municipal officials. - Technical Proficiency: Skilled in using relevant software tools and adaptable in learning new systems that enhance operational efficiency.
